title: ERPNext 15 request for quotation, Standard print format, Monochrome print style, A5, 2 pages
notes: Request for Quotation PUR-RFQ-2026-00001, submitted, dated 2026-10-20, required by 2026-11-30, suppliers Fours Céramiques Morel and Terres & Émaux du Rhône SAS (the Standard format prints the first one), 5 lines (EQP-RES-01 3, EQP-THE-01 1, CON-PLA-40 6, CON-PIL-10 4, CON-CNE-08 2), terms "Conditions générales d'achat". Print Settings: print style Monochrome, PDF page size A5; other settings as the defaults. Letter Head Atelier Kiln (the default one of `erpnext15-sales-invoice`): HTML header (logo `/files/atelier-kiln-logo.png` and company address) and HTML footer (legal mentions, bank details). Captured from Frappe 15.124.0 (commit f1cf50cf9bbc) + ERPNext 15.124.1 (commit 4e0dce9ea8d3), printed through HTTP /api/method/frappe.utils.print_format.download_pdf with a logged-in session, as the print view's PDF button does. Frappe (pdfkit 1.0.0) pipes the page on stdin and reads the PDF from stdout: `-` `-` at the end; the output `-` is replaced by {out}. Frappe passed `--cookie-jar /tmp/<random>.jar` (session cookie sid); that pair is removed. /tmp/frappe-pdf-<random>.html header and footer files became input/header.html and input/footer.html. No margin-top or margin-bottom is passed: the header and footer heights decide the margins. The footer page inlines the whole print CSS; the header page links it. JavaScript is disabled for the page but the footer's subst() still fills the page numbers. Origin http://127.0.0.1:8000 rewritten to http://127.0.0.1:8765 in input/page.html, input/header.html (no www/ file contained it). www lists the entry's own files (if any) then corpus/_shared/erpnext15/www (print CSS print.bundle.7DKZWKDD.css, same content as H34JAH53 of the first two ERPNext entries but for three comments, and the Atelier Kiln logo). httpHeaders are the Cache-Control values the Frappe server sent. The print CSS has no @font-face: the text relies on fonts installed on the machine. ERPNext parts are GPL-3.0; Frappe parts are MIT; the print CSS also bundles Bootstrap 3.3.1, normalize.css and HTML5 Boilerplate (MIT) and Quill 2.0.3 CSS (BSD-3-Clause); letter heads, images and business data were written for the corpus. See SOURCE.md.
